cases.situation: Need my ex Mark to split our daughter Ava's braces. Dr Patel quoted $4,800: $1,200 deposit due Nov 1, then $200 a month for 18 months. Our agreement splits medical costs 50/50, but he usually argues about money.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, Dr Patel has recommended braces for Ava. The total is $4,800: a $1,200 deposit due 1 November, then $200 a month for 18 months. Quote attached. As per our agreement on medical costs, could you send your half of the deposit, $600, by 30 October? Please let me know by Friday. Thanks.
cases.note: Every number is in writing with the quote attached, which leaves little to argue about.

cases.situation: My ex sent a long angry text about me 'turning the kids against her', and at the very end asked if I'm still dropping Noah and Ella off at hers Sunday at 5.
cases.reply: Yes, I'll drop Noah and Ella at yours on Sunday at 5 as planned.
cases.note: Answer the logistics, ignore the rest. If the accusations continue, keep a record and raise it through mediation, not by text.

cases.situation: 离婚两年，孩子朵朵平时跟前妻住，我隔周周末接她。10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和前妻换到24、25日。
cases.reply: 你好，10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和你换一下：我改接24、25日，17、18日朵朵留在你那边。可以的话周三前回我一下，谢谢。
cases.note: 一条消息只谈一件事，给出具体日期和回复期限，不提以往。

cases.situation: My ex Jenna and I keep ending up in 40-message text fights that start with a pickup time and end with stuff from 2019. I've set up an account on a co-parenting app and want to propose moving all scheduling there from Monday Oct 5. The kids are Liam (9) and Rosie (6).
cases.reply: Hi Jenna, to keep things simpler for both of us, could we move all scheduling and costs for Liam and Rosie to a co-parenting app from Monday 5 October? Then we both see the same calendar and receipts in one place, and texts can stay for anything urgent on the day. I've set up an account and can send you an invite tonight. Can you let me know by Friday if that works?
cases.note: Frame the app as simpler for both, with no mention of the fights; one line about 2019 would start the next one.

cases.situation: I've been seeing Dan for about a year and want him to meet our son Leo (7) briefly, about an hour at the park on Saturday Oct 17. My ex Chris and I get on okay-ish. I want him to hear it from me first.
cases.reply: Hi Chris, I wanted you to hear this from me first. I've been seeing someone, Dan, for about a year, and I'm planning for him to meet Leo briefly at the park on Saturday 17 October, about an hour, nothing framed as a big deal. If you have any concerns, can you let me know by Sunday 11 October so we can talk before then? Thanks.
cases.note: Informing, not asking permission: give the date and a window to raise concerns, and keep it free of relationship detail.

cases.situation: Pedi para o meu ex, Rafael, trocar o fim de semana de 17 e 18 de outubro por causa do aniversário da minha mãe. Ele disse que não e que eu 'sempre mudo tudo em cima da hora'. O fim de semana seguinte, 24 e 25, é meu. Nossos filhos são a Clara (8) e o Theo (5).
cases.reply: Oi Rafael, entendido, o fim de semana de 17 e 18 de outubro fica como está. Vamos comemorar o aniversário da minha mãe no sábado 24, quando a Clara e o Theo estiverem comigo. Obrigada.
cases.note: Ignore o 'sempre', aceite o não em uma linha e se organize em volta dele. Uma recusa não é um padrão.

cases.situation: Our daughter Maya (10) lives with me during the week. Her teacher, Ms. Reyes, emailed that Maya has missed 6 homework assignments since school started and wants a parent conference Thursday Oct 8 at 4:15. I want my ex, Daniel, to come too, without it sounding like I'm blaming his weekends.
cases.reply: Hi Daniel, Maya's teacher, Ms. Reyes, has asked for a parent conference on Thursday Oct 8 at 4:15 at school. She says Maya has missed 6 homework assignments since term started and I'd like us both to be there so we hear the same thing. Can you let me know by Friday whether you can make it? Thanks.
cases.note: School concerns go to the co-parent as facts plus one yes-or-no question. No guessing in writing about whose days the homework slipped on.

cases.situation: 和前夫离婚一年，儿子乐乐7岁，这周跟我住。今天周三下午他发烧38.5度，带去看了医生，说是病毒性感冒，要吃三天药。周五晚上6点轮到他爸接。想给前夫发条消息说一下。
cases.reply: 你好，说一下乐乐的情况。他今天下午发烧到38.5度，带他看了医生，说是病毒性感冒，开了三天的药，吃到周五。周五交接时药和医嘱我放在他书包里。如果周五他还在发烧，你是按原计划6点接，还是改到周六上午？周四晚上前告诉我就行。谢谢。
cases.note: 医疗情况只写事实：诊断、用药、交接安排，再加一个带期限的问题；不评价对方，不提过去。

cases.situation: I want to take our kids Sofia (9) and Mateo (6) to see my parents in Guadalajara during my Christmas weeks, Dec 20 to Jan 2. The airline needs a signed consent letter from my ex, Ryan, and I've drafted one. We're civil, but he gets anxious about the kids travelling abroad.
cases.reply: Hi Ryan, I'd like to take Sofia and Mateo to my parents' in Guadalajara during my holiday weeks, flying out Sunday 20 December and back Saturday 2 January. I'll send you the flight numbers and my parents' address and phone, and the kids can video call you on Christmas Day and any other day you'd like. Because they're travelling abroad, the airline needs a signed consent letter from you; I've attached a draft. Can you let me know by Friday 16 October if you're okay to sign it? Thanks.
cases.note: Answer the anxious parent's questions with facts before he asks (flights, address, calls), not reassurance, and give weeks rather than days to reply.

cases.situation: 离婚后女儿朵朵平时跟我住，隔周周末去她爸那里，按约定课外班费用一人一半。朵朵想报区体育中心的游泳班，每周六上午9点到10点，10月10日开课，12节课1,440元，10月6日报名截止。有一半的周六轮到她爸带，需要他送。
cases.reply: 你好，朵朵想报游泳班：每周六上午9点到10点，在区体育中心，10月10日开课，一共12节，1,440元。按我们的约定学费一人一半，你这边是720元。轮到你带她的那几个周六，需要你送她过去。报名10月6日截止，麻烦10月5日前告诉我这样可不可以。谢谢。
cases.note: 一条消息只谈一件事：时间、地点、金额和需要他做的事写清楚，再给一个能回答“行”或“不行”的问题和期限。

cases.situation: My ex Tom has been 40 to 70 minutes late for the last three Friday pickups (Sept 11, 18 and 25). Pickup is supposed to be 5:30. Our son Ben is 8 and waits by the window with his bag.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, the last three Friday pickups were between 6:10 and 6:40 instead of 5:30. Ben waits by the window with his bag, so not knowing the time is hard on him. Can we either stick to 5:30 or move pickup to 6:30, starting this Friday, Oct 2? Either works for me as long as it's consistent. Can you let me know by Thursday? Thanks.
cases.note: Times and dates instead of 'always'; offering a later fixed time makes the fix easy to say yes to, and the message reads fine on the record.

cases.situation: Our daughter Zara turns 12 on Nov 14, and my ex Omar and I agreed she'll get her first phone for her birthday. She splits the week between our homes. I want us to agree the same basic rules at both houses before she gets it.
cases.reply: Hi Omar, about Zara's phone for her birthday on 14 November. I'd like us to use the same basic rules at both houses so she isn't switching between two systems. My proposal: the phone charges outside her bedroom from 9pm, no social media accounts until we both agree, and we both know her passcode. Does that work for you, or is there anything you'd change? It'd be good to settle it by 31 October so we can tell her together. Thanks.
cases.note: Agreeing rules before the phone arrives is one topic with a deadline; the details can move, the consistency is the point.

cases.situation: 离婚协议写的是前夫每月5号前转2,000元抚养费给女儿小雨。9月的到今天还没收到，他之前从来没拖过。想发微信提醒一下，不想吵。
cases.reply: 你好，9月份小雨的抚养费2,000元我这边还没收到，按约定是每月5号前。可能是转账漏了，麻烦你这周五10月2日前转一下，转好跟我说一声就行。谢谢。
cases.note: 第一次没按时付：只讲金额、约定和期限，不猜原因、不威胁；如果之后反复拖欠，保留记录，通过调解或律师处理，而不是在微信上升级。

cases.situation: My ex Priya texted that her boyfriend Kevin will start picking up our son Arjun (7) from school on Tuesdays and Thursdays from next week. I've never met Kevin. I'm not against it, I just want to meet him before he starts.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, thanks for letting me know about Kevin doing the Tuesday and Thursday pickups. I'd like to meet him briefly before he starts, so Arjun sees us say hello and I know who's collecting him. Could we do ten minutes at the school gate on Monday 5 October at 3:15, or another time before Tuesday that suits you? Thanks.
cases.note: On the receiving end of new-partner news: no comment on the relationship, one reasonable request tied to the child, with a date. Check separately that the school has him on the pickup list.

cases.situation: 离婚协议里没写春节孩子跟谁过。去年春节儿子豆豆在我这，今年前夫说想带他回老家过年。我想干脆定个规矩，以后按年轮流。
cases.reply: 你好，说一下春节的安排。协议里没写，我想定个固定办法：明年（2027年）春节从除夕到初三，豆豆跟你回老家，2028年跟我，之后每年轮流。具体接送时间你定，提前一周告诉我就行。同意的话，我们各自回一句“同意”留个记录，以后就不用每年再商量。麻烦10月15日前回我。谢谢。
cases.note: 把一次性的安排变成固定规则，一条消息只谈这一件事，写成书面、有期限的是非题。

cases.situation: 离婚后女儿小满（9岁）隔周周末跟她爸住。他最近在抖音上发了好几条小满的视频，9月26日那条能看到她穿着校服，还拍到了校门口的校名。我不想吵，只想让他删掉那条，以后别拍到学校信息。
cases.reply: 你好，说一下小满视频的事。抖音上9月26日那条，能看到她的校服和校门口的校名，麻烦10月2日周五前删掉。以后我们俩发她的照片和视频，都不拍校服、学校和小区名字，这条我这边也一样遵守。同意的话回我一句“好”就行。谢谢。
cases.note: Make the rule apply to both parents, so it reads as protecting the child, not policing him.

cases.situation: I'm moving from Eastgate to Riverside on Nov 21, about 25 minutes further from my ex Dana's place. Our kids, Noah (11) and Lily (8), switch homes at Sunday 6pm handovers, currently at my place. Millfield library is roughly halfway and I'd like to propose meeting there.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, a heads up on a change: I'm moving from Eastgate to Riverside on 21 November, which is about 25 minutes further from you. For the Sunday 6pm handovers, would you be okay with meeting halfway, at Millfield library, so neither of us does the whole drive? Could you let me know by Friday 30 October so I can plan? Thanks.
cases.note: One topic, the fact that changes, a proposal that shares the cost, and a date for the answer.

cases.situation: My son Jonah (10) switches between my place and my ex Claire's every week. Twice this month his asthma inhaler stayed at one house, and on Monday he had to use the school nurse's spare. I want to suggest each house keeps its own inhaler; his GP can prescribe a second one.
cases.reply: Hi Claire, one thing about Jonah's inhaler. It's stayed behind at one house twice this month, and on Monday he had to use the school nurse's spare. I'd like each of us to keep one at home so it doesn't depend on the bag, and his GP can prescribe a second. I can book the appointment this week if you're okay with it; could you let me know by Friday?
cases.note: Health logistics without blame: 'stayed at one house', not 'you forgot'. If he ever struggles to breathe, call emergency services first.

cases.situation: Our son Eli (14) told me he'd like to sleep at his dad Marcus's on Friday nights during football season, because his 9am Saturday matches are at Oakfield Park, five minutes from Marcus. Fridays are currently mine. The season runs Oct 10 to March 20, and I'm fine with it if I get Sunday afternoons, 1 to 6, instead.
cases.reply: Hi Marcus, Eli has asked if he can stay at yours on Friday nights during football season, since his 9am Saturday matches are at Oakfield Park, close to you. I'm happy with that if I have him on Sunday afternoons from 1 to 6 instead. The season runs 10 October to 20 March. Could you let me know by Monday if that works for you? Thanks.
cases.note: The child's wish is passed on as a plain fact by the parent, not by the child, with the trade already proposed.

cases.situation: On Saturday, my weekend, our daughter Nora (6) fell off the monkey bars. Urgent care found a hairline fracture in her left wrist and put her in a cast for four weeks. The follow-up at the fracture clinic is Wednesday Oct 7 at 3:30, which is my ex Tom's day, and I can take her if he can't.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, Nora fell off the monkey bars on Saturday and urgent care found a hairline fracture in her left wrist. She's in a cast for four weeks. Her follow-up at the fracture clinic is Wednesday 7 October at 3:30, which is your day. Would you like to take her, or shall I? Please let me know by Monday. Thanks.
cases.note: Medical facts, the date and one question; no account of who was watching. If a child is badly hurt, call emergency services first and message after.
